cards.claim: S. John Ross trained with the silhouette artist Budd-Jack and worked as a silhouette artist.
cards.quote: Inspired by an artist that he saw at Michigan State Fair, he trained with the silhouette artist Budd-Jack, travelling around to different fairs for three years.

cards.claim: S. John Ross is a sculptor who creates works such as 12-foot plaster birthday cakes, resin and bronze brooms, and robots.
cards.quote: it began , he ’ s here , covered in sawdust , finding humanity in gnarled wood , baking 12-foot plaster birthday cakes for everyone , casting his brooms in resin and bronze , building robots and writing code .
